title: Decision tree error probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates over $\Omega$ with real labels, and let $f\colon(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\mathbb{R}$. The error probability is the product mean, with independent coordinate law $\pi$, of the indicator that the tree's output differs from $f$ on the input.
hypotheses_covered: Finite decision tree with real labels
